### Fixed
- **The meta chart's forwarded values carry the Hugging Face download CDN pattern, and a mirrored egress list can no longer drift between the two charts** (giantswarm/agent-platform#522, round 2; proof 1 of giantswarm/giantswarm#37639). #523 (4.28.17) added `*.*.*.hf.co` to the connectivity chart's defaults only. The meta chart forwards its whole values tree to the connectivity release (`templates/components.yaml`, `forwardAllValues`), and a forwarded copy of a default shadows the child's own, so an installation's connectivity release still rendered the four old patterns from `modelServing.networkPolicy.huggingFace.fqdns` and `modelManager.networkPolicy.huggingFace.fqdns` of `helm/agent-platform/values.yaml` (gazelle 2026-09-17 04:30Z: Helm storage's supplied `.config` with four entries beside the chart's five; the three serving CNPs unchanged, the download would have been dropped exactly as before; caught before a model was loaded). Both meta lists gain `*.*.*.hf.co`, and the meta chart's `huggingFace` and `policies.env` comments are the connectivity chart's (the #520 rationale corrected in #523 was still the meta copy's). Two checks hold the two charts together: `make verify-meta` (`tests/verify-mirrored-values.py`) asserts the meta chart's copy of every `networkPolicy` `fqdns` / `cidrs` list equals the connectivity chart's default, naming the path that differs, with a negative control (a list short of one entry fails, naming `modelServing.networkPolicy.huggingFace.fqdns`); `make verify-model-serving-policies` renders the connectivity chart a second time from the values the meta chart forwards to its release (the meta chart's defaults, the model serving switch on) and matches the `HUB_HOSTS` fixture against those three CNPs too — the render an installation gets, not only the child's defaults; against the previous meta values it fails naming `us.aws.cdn.hf.co`. The live half — the weights on the claim, the predictor Ready, `/v1/chat/completions` answering — is the proof's.
